post.description: Request contracts for GPT Image standard generation and existing separate models.

prompt.description: The complete prompt must satisfy all three limits: 8192 Unicode code points, 16384 UTF-8 bytes, and 5000 tokens counted by this service with o200k_base. Whitespace counts toward the limits, and a whitespace-only prompt is invalid. These are the standard service's operating limits, not the 32000-character vendor limit for the separate Flare / Sunburst models. The local token count does not represent final supplier billing usage or guarantee a per-request procurement cost ceiling. Over-limit prompts are rejected before reserving funds or sending a supplier request, without truncating, compressing, or replacing them.

size.description: Only the seven listed aspect ratios and exact pixel sizes are supported. Omission or an empty string uses 1024x1024. The 3:4 and 4:3 labels are approximate; the old 1024x1365 and 1365x1024 sizes are no longer accepted. When both size and aspect_ratio are present, they must resolve to the same pixels.

aspect_ratio.description: Only the seven listed aspect ratios and exact pixel sizes are supported. Omission or an empty string uses 1024x1024. The 3:4 and 4:3 labels are approximate; the old 1024x1365 and 1365x1024 sizes are no longer accepted. When both size and aspect_ratio are present, they must resolve to the same pixels.

output_format.description: PNG output only. JPEG / WebP are supported reference-input formats only.

group.description: An optional existing authorized routing override; ordinary standard use does not require supplier selection. It is not forwarded as a supplier parameter.

seed.description: A nonnegative integer within the service's accepted integer range.
A nonnegative integer within the service's accepted integer range.

oneOf.description: A public HTTPS reference image in JPEG, PNG, or WebP format, up to 5 MiB (5242880 bytes), 40000000 decoded pixels, and 23170 pixels on either edge. The URL must not contain credentials or a fragment; the final destination must also pass public-network checks. At most one reference is allowed across all aliases, including duplicate values. Base64 and file uploads are not accepted.

prompt.description: The vendor prompt limit for separate Flare / Sunburst models remains 32000 characters; this standard-service change does not alter their contracts. This page does not assert an unverified hd limit.

n.description: Image count, subject to the selected model and route limits.

size.description: Accepted sizes depend on the selected model and route.

quality.description: Quality options depend on the selected model and route.

images.description: Retains the existing separate-model reference-field contract; its limits are not derived from the standard service's one-reference limit.

example.prompt: An adult male character sheet on white: a facial close-up on the left and a full-body view on the right, with a consistent appearance.

200.description: Image results or the accepted original asynchronous task.

schema.description: Read image results or an asynchronous task according to the returned shape. Task acceptance does not mean an image is complete.

id.description: The original asynchronous task ID, when returned. Continue polling that task.

400.description: Invalid input or parameters outside the standard service's reviewed scope.
